Support

Questions, problems or ideas? Email contactus@logicagent.co. We usually reply within two working days. Please don’t send your plan data or account numbers.

Common questions

How do I move my plan between the website and the app?
Use “Copy plan data” on one, then “Paste plan data” on the other. Saved scenarios come along too.

I bought Pro on another device.
Open More → FIRE Planner Pro → Restore purchases, signed in with the same Apple Account. Your plan itself isn’t synced; copy it across as above.

How do I cancel Pro Annual?
In Settings on your iPhone, tap your name → Subscriptions → FIRE Planner. You keep Pro until the end of the paid year.

I asked Apple for a refund.
Refunds are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. If Pro ends, everything you created stays readable.

The widget says “Open FIRE Planner”.
Open the app once so it can share your countdown with the widget.

Is my data safe?
It never leaves your device. See the Privacy Policy.
